blocks.text: Reaction ka rate constant k do tareeqon se nikala ja sakta hai: initial concentration (initial rates) ka tareeqa, aur pehle order ki reactions ke liye half-life ka tareeqa.

blocks.caption: Dono tareeqe
rows: Kai maloom concentrations par initial rates
k = rate / (concentrations ka un ke orders par hasil-e-zarb)

blocks.prompt: Doosre order ki reaction ke liye kaun sa tareeqa istemal ho sakta hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Initial concentration ka tareeqa, kyunke yeh kisi bhi order ke liye kaam karta hai: maloom concentrations par initial rate napein aur rate law ki concentration terms se taqseem karein. Sada half-life taalluq k = 0.693 / t1/2 sirf pehle order ki reactions ke liye hai, jin ki half-life concentration se azad hai.

items: k tak do raste: maloom concentrations par initial rates (koi bhi order), aur half-life taalluq k = 0.693 / t1/2 (pehla order).
